patch_interpretation: HR 96 as in released loader; paper input-patch wording ambiguous

details.product_choice: Paper did not specify GHRSST product; MUR chosen for matching date and native 0.01-degree resolution
details.coverage: global ocean between 70S and70N; candidate grid only used to locate tiles
details.native_sampling: Each HR tile fetched at stride1, original0.01degree; candidate centers 1degree apart so 96px tiles do not overlap
details.mask: all native pixels finite SST and explicit open-sea mask; exclude land/ice flags. Missing sea_ice_fraction at open-water pixels is not rejected
